notes: Plain Express + socket.io app (node 18.20.8 via mise; `npm ci`). There's no database: rooms and chat exist only while people are connected. start.sh runs `node -r .ui-capture/dev-entry.js src/app.js` on $PORT (src/app.js changed only to read process.env.PORT) and then starts the stub participants. Entry /join drops you, as 'Sam Okafor', into the team's recurring call room 'Tidewater_Weekly Sync_2813309571' (the odd underscore/space mix comes from the app's own room-link generator). There you get the navbar (Unique Identifier, video/mic/screen-share/record toggles, chat toggle with a red 'New' badge, leave), your local camera preview in the bottom-left (needs camera permission; it stays empty with no camera), and the chat pane (click the comment icon), filled with a 50-message weekly product sync among 4 teammates of a marina slip-reservation startup: agenda, incident notes, Jira/Figma/GitHub/Notion links (auto-linked), short replies, emoji, a dropped-connection aside. Every chat message carries the current time, because the app timestamps on receipt. Other screens: '/' = Create Room form (also where the Leave button goes); '/?room=<anything>' with no stored name = 'Your Name' form; the Record button opens the record video/screen modal. Opening the room in a second tab replays the history to everyone in the room again.
